summary: 45 Flour with no Wheat Fields: make Glass at a Glassworks (3 Sticks for 2 panes), trade it at the Tropiclands Trading Outpost (8 Glass for 9 Wheat) and mill it. That's about 40 Glass and 60 Sticks. The Watchtower is 15 Planks.

build_order.note: First objective: its build site is already placed, so it only needs the 15 Planks delivered.
6 Logs; 13 Stone per Glassworks, 12 for the Outpost.
Two, 8 Bricks + 13 Stone each; about 6 to 7.5 panes a day each.
Optional 100 Veggies in Markets: Corn or Tomato (Jaqweshia speeds veggies).

pitfalls: The Outpost burns a fire for each trade as well, so Sticks feed both the Glassworks and the trades.
Heat waves slow walking; keep Cooling covered.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
